note: Rules are matched on system names and scope text in the draft only. The reviewer has no view into the connected systems.

rules.name: Write without prior approval
rules.text: A write action on an identity or finance system needs an approval step, with a named approver, earlier in the workflow.

rules.name: Scope not narrower than admin
rules.text: The permission scope of a write step must be narrower than admin. Admin, owner, root, full access, wildcard and organization-wide scopes are flagged.
